_comment: Canonical docs layout map (ADR-0045). Each key is one fact category with exactly one owning document per layout. Paths are relative to the project's docs write root (the first context_paths entry, scripts/lib/docs_root.py). A null path means the layout has no such document. Read through scripts/lib/docs_root.py (doc_path) or scripts/doc-path.sh — never hardcode a path that this map owns. .dev-team-agents/templates/process-template.md mirrors the gated column and a test fails on drift.
_layout_key: project.json `docs_layout`. Absent means `development`, so every project bound before this key existed keeps its layout unchanged. `/devteam:setup` writes `gated` for a new project only.

source.owns: Raw inputs — meetings, brainstorms, scope docs, dated, never edited

prd.owns: Product rules with stable IDs PRD-<section>-R<n>, each citing its source

glossary.owns: Domain terms — term, user-language word, definition, code/table/endpoint name

nfr.owns: Non-functional requirements NFR-<nn> — target, how measured, status

trd.owns: Index of the technical documents — links only, no rule-level detail

architecture.owns: System design, layers, module map, integration patterns

tech-stack.owns: Chosen technologies with rationale and rejected alternatives

code-standards.owns: Patterns, naming, linting rules specific to this project

data-model.owns: Schema — Data Model Specification: logical overview, ER diagram per area, data dictionary, PII tags

api-contracts.owns: Endpoints — API style, versioning, auth model, envelopes, every endpoint

threat-model.owns: Threats per trust boundary and the personal-data map

adr.owns: Architecture decision records — directory resolved by new-adr.sh --dir

design-tokens.owns: Canonical visual values — W3C Design Tokens

design-system.owns: Usage rules referencing token names, component inventory

design-prototypes.owns: Raw design-tool exports, one dated folder per feature import, never edited

design-flows.owns: Per-feature screen flows — route, states, elements, navigation

evals.owns: LLM eval cases, metrics and pass thresholds per AI task

testing.owns: Testing strategy — levels, tooling, fixtures, what runs where

process.owns: The flow, its gates, the Definition of Ready and the owner table

backlog-index.owns: The single sprint index (gated: also global DoD and DoR)

backlog-readme.owns: Backlog tracker and sprint file list

dod.owns: Definition of Done shared by every scope

overview.owns: Per-scope overview-<scope-slug>.md (gated: deliveries and links only)

wiki.owns: Non-obvious domain knowledge, retrieval index at wiki/README.md
